pagedata.pyDescription: CREATE A WORK PAGE FOR A COVERED OR NON COVERED WORK OBJECT WITH ALL THE REQUIRED PROPERTY VALUES. THIS ROUTINE DEFAULTS PROPERTY VALUES ON THE WORK PAGE USING THE MODEL OF THE CLASS OR SPECIFIED MODEL MODELTOUSE OR THE MODEL DEFINED TO THE SPECIFIED FLOW FLOWTYPE. IT ALSO USES THE FLOWTYPE PARAMETER TO SET THE PYFLOWNAME PROPERTY ON THE WORK PAGE. ADDITIONAL DATA FOR THE WORK PAGE CAN BE PASSED USING THE MERGEPAGE.
